summary: Iter 95 — Frontend-only verification of the WEB /org-listing LOGO bug fix + new COVER PHOTO crop + Public Preview + extras gallery (showSetCover=false). All 7 scenarios PASS on web for both PSSS (Community Partner, no logo, 3 photos) and WTYC (regular org, has logo, 1 photo). The logo placeholder bug is fixed — PSSS with null logo now shows a circular dashed container with the burgee/flag icon centered (data-testid logo-placeholder) plus an 'Upload a logo' button (logo-pick); no broken image anywhere on the page. logo-crop-modal opens from logo-pick with logo-zoom + logo-crop-cancel (closes cleanly). COVER FEATURE verified: cover-uploader renders; PSSS shows cover-current with cover-change + cover-remove; cover-change opens cover-crop-modal with cover-crop-save + cover-crop-cancel (closes cleanly); cover-remove on a CP with extras cleanly promotes the first extra to the new cover (expected cascade per OrgListing.jsx:77). Public Preview (cover-public-preview) renders with cover-preview-img, the correct tier badge ('Community Partner' gold for PSSS, 'Club / Org' teal for WTYC), live logo + name + @handle updates (verified by typing a new org name — preview updated instantly). Extras gallery for PSSS (CP) shows 2 items (3 total − 1 cover), 0 gallery-cover-badge and 0 gallery-set-cover-* buttons (showSetCover=false working as spec), gallery-caption-N inputs editable, 2 gallery-remove-* and gallery-add present. For WTYC (regular org) the entire 'More photos' section + org-gallery-editor are hidden (galleryMax=0, max_photos=1). No stale 'Event flyer' label anywhere on the page.
critical_code_review_comments: LogoUploader.jsx L38 useEffect correctly resets `broken` whenever `value` changes, so selecting a fresh file (or receiving a new URL) clears any prior null/invalid error state cleanly — matches the bug-fix spec.

LogoUploader.jsx L70 img onError={() => setBroken(true)} makes hasLogo flip to false and re-render the placeholder, so an unreachable/invalid logo URL falls back to the burgee placeholder (not a broken image icon). Verified by code review — would need a DB-level invalid URL to exercise at runtime.
CoverPhotoUploader.jsx mirrors the same broken/useEffect pattern (L39, L41, L75), so an invalid cover URL also falls back to the cover-placeholder cleanly.

OrgListing.jsx L77 `setCover('')` sets photos to just `extras`, which means removing the cover on a CP with extras promotes the first extra to the new cover. This is sensible UX cascade but note that for regular orgs (no extras) cover-remove cleanly returns to cover-placeholder (which was not exercised at runtime but is implied by the same code path with empty extras).
OrgListing.jsx L127 `galleryMax > 0` gate correctly hides both the 'More photos' label AND the OrgGalleryEditor for regular orgs (max_photos=1 → galleryMax=0). Verified on WTYC.

OrgListing.jsx L131 passes `showSetCover={false}` to OrgGalleryEditor; OrgGalleryEditor.jsx L45/L51 correctly gate both the cover badge and the 'Set as cover' button on `showSetCover`, so mobile (default true) is unaffected — nice parity-preserving flag.

Public preview (OrgListing.jsx L101-124) uses the `isCP` state + live form.{org_name,handle,logo_url} + cover.url, so it updates reactively as the user edits — verified by typing a new org name on WTYC. No API round-trip needed for the preview.
